items.title: Demna's Gucci Back Under the Microscope at Milan Fashion Week
items.summary: BoF previews Demna's sophomore Gucci ready-to-wear show (Spring/Summer 2027, staged Sept 25 in Milan) as a critical test of whether his creative reset is translating into commercial momentum a year after his debut. The piece frames the show as both a creative and a financial referendum for Kering's flagship brand heading into fashion month.

items.title: Gucci Fall 2026 Ready to Wear Runway, Fashion Show & Collection Review
items.summary: WWD's runway archive/review coverage of Gucci's Fall 2026 collection under Demna, revisited this week as trade press frames expectations ahead of the Sept 25 Milan show. Coverage notes continued references to the Tom Ford and Alessandro Michele eras within Demna's body-conscious design language.

items.title: Salma Hayek Pinault, Dakota Johnson, Pamela Anderson and Benicio Del Toro Among Kering Foundation's Caring for Women Dinner Co-Hosts
items.summary: Kering Foundation's fifth annual Caring for Women dinner in Manhattan, coinciding with New York Fashion Week, raised over five million dollars; the evening featured a live auction of items from Kering houses including Gucci, with celebrities wearing Gucci on the red carpet.

items.title: Pamela Anderson leads the best dressed stars in thigh split gown at the Kering Foundation's Dinner
items.summary: Style coverage of Pamela Anderson wearing a Gucci gown with a high thigh slit at the Kering Foundation dinner in New York, part of broader NYFW celebrity dressing coverage that surfaces Gucci in a positive lifestyle/red-carpet context.

items.title: Gucci Morty dance-trend edits and #gucci tag activity
items.summary: General TikTok community activity under the #gucci tag includes a recurring meme trend ('Gucci Morty' character edited into the 'Jumper' dance trend) alongside outfit and styling content; this is fandom/meme volume rather than brand-driven content, indicating organic but low-signal brand mention volume on the platform this week.

items.title: Gucci sub-forum ongoing authentication and product discussion
items.summary: Active PurseForum Gucci community continues running authentication-request threads and product discussion (e.g., Horsebit 1955, GG Marmont, Flora-print pieces); recurring theme in 2026 threads is heightened caution around counterfeits that closely replicate serial tags and hardware, reflecting consumer anxiety about authenticity in the resale/gifting market.

items.title: Gucci Resale Value: Do Bags Hold Up? (2026 Guide)
items.summary: Resale-market analysis reports that current Gucci styles in very good condition typically resell for 55-80% of retail while older Alessandro Michele-era pieces have dropped to 30-50% of retail, with some Sylvie bags that retailed near $2,700-3,200 now reselling for $1,400-2,200 -- a critical-angle data point suggesting eroding secondary-market confidence in legacy logo-heavy designs even as current pieces hold value better.

items.title: Gucci Bag Prices 2026: Full Price Guide (US & Europe)
items.summary: Consumer-facing price guide documents continued annual Gucci price increases into 2026 driven by materials, labor, currency and US import cost pressure, noting entry-level GG Marmont pricing now starts near $1,150-1,450; guide flags that some price-sensitive buyers are pausing purchases or shifting to brands like Telfar and Polene as 'loud logo' fatigue spreads -- a recurring critical/backlash theme around affordability.
